newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy, Hungary, Slovenia cooperate on EU, defence.
newsitem.headline: Italy, Hungary, Slovenia cooperate on EU, defence.

text.p: Italy said on Friday it was setting up a task force with Hungary and Slovenia to monitor the two central European states' negotiations on joining the EU.
The move was announced to reporters by Deputy Foreign Minister Piero Fassino after talks with his colleagues Istvan Szent-Ivanyi from Hungary and Ignac Golob from Slovenia.

Fassino said Italy "confirms its full support" for the accession of Hungary and Slovenia into the European Union and NATO and said the three had discussed setting up a "trilateral brigade" to cooperate on defence training and infrastructure.
Foreign ministers of Italy, Slovenia and Hungary agreed last October to strengthen trilateral ties to shape regional policy in security, transport and other areas.
Fassino said the three prime ministers would meet in Budapest in May and defence ministers could meet soon in Slovenia to discuss the trilateral brigade plan.
